announcements.title: Now Registering: Veterans Day 5K
announcements.body: The First Annual Veterans Healing Farm 5K & Kids Fun Run is open for registration — November 8, 2026.
announcements.registrationNote: Opt-in: this slide exists to drive signups, so it carries the race QR. Most announcements (a closure, a thank-you) have nothing to register for and must not.
